title: We Are Waiting for Imam Mahdi (a)
body:
We ask Allah (swt) for reconciliation and with madad of al-Haqq there should be peace for the believers and
sincere ones. Sayyidina Muhammad (s) said:
There will come after me khalifahs, and after khalifahs princes will come, and after princes kings will come,
and after kings tyrants will come. Then a man comes from my Family who will fill the Earth with justice as it
was previously filled with justice.
Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a) will come to the ummah with kings and ministers to Sham, to southern Syria in a
place called Qadam, where he will takbeer, “Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar!” and technology will
finish with those three takbeers. All kings and their ministers will be there, and he will be imam of all
Muslims from east to west. May Allah make this salvation come quickly!
Fatihah.
I have been waiting for Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a) since 1940, observing for seventy years, and my heart is
attached to his appearance! Allah, Allah, Allah. Inshaa-Allah we will reach Mahdi (a).
Mashaa-Allah, our dear guests honor us (with their visit). (...)

(Guest: People are afraid, asking what they can do.)
They should not be afraid (of what is coming); rather, they should fear from Allah Almighty. Don't be afraid
of the rockets, no. There will be a sign on the heads from whomever Allah (swt) wants to take His revenge
and there is no escape for them! They must pray the five prayers or something will come on their heads and if
they don't pray, they will get swept away. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar al-Akbar! Allahu Akbar.
May Allah reform all matters as the time has now come. I am waiting for Mahdi (a)! He will rule for seven
years, then Sayyidina `Isa (a) will descend and take charge of all matters for forty years, then Judgment Day
will occur. O Sayyidee! O Your Highness, the Prince. Yaa Rabbee, shukr! (Du`a)
Fatihah.
Lefke, 29.11.2011 (Translated from Arabic)
